title: FSM Decision Packet Schema
description: Strict data contract for FSM decision packets generated by the Shadow Diagnostic Engine under the SIA Framework. Curated by MSK.

packet_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifying the decision event packet.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with UTC offset recording exact state alignment time.

fsm_state_id.description: Deterministic state machine state identifier mapped from unstructured input.

context_latency_ms.description: End-to-end processing and alignment latency in milliseconds.

transient_flush_verified.description: Verification flag confirming raw text buffer was immediately flushed.

raw_text_retained.description: Mandatory compliance check: raw conversational data must never be retained.
